matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: DINO achieves around 63 AP on COCO 2017 val with a Swin-L backbone, setting a new state of the art for object detection at the time of publication.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: DINO obtains the best results on COCO test-dev (63.3 AP) after pre-training on Objects365 with a SwinL backbone.

matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: DINO upgrades DETR-style detectors via three pieces: a contrastive denoising training objective, a hybrid query selection used to seed anchors, and a refined two-step look-ahead box update.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: DINO introduces a contrastive denoising training method to avoid duplicate outputs.
